name: TC-BF-006 — Brief驳回后买手重新编辑与版本管理 [P1]
description: 验证驳回后买手看到驳回信息、点击重新编辑fork新版本、版本侧栏展示v1/v2

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const hasRejectInfo = text.includes('驳回原因') || text.includes('驳回'); const reEditBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('重新编辑')); return { hasRejectInfo, reEditBtn: !!reEditBtn }; })()
steps.description: 验证驳回后展示驳回信息和重新编辑按钮
首版驳回前不展示版本侧栏

steps.expression: (() => { const reEditBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('重新编辑')); if (reEditBtn) { reEditBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const sidebar = document.querySelector('[class*=version], [class*=sidebar]'); const text = document.body.textContent; const hasV1 = text.includes('v1'); const hasV2 = text.includes('v2'); const formEditable = !!document.querySelector('input:not([readonly]), textarea:not([readonly])'); return { versionSidebarAfter: !!sidebar, hasV1, hasV2, formEditable }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 迭代状态为REJECTED_BRIEF，当前用户是店铺买手
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入Brief tab看到驳回信息
2. 验证首版驳回前无版本侧栏
3. 点击重新编辑Brief
4. 验证fork后展示v1/v2版本侧栏
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 驳回提示区展示驳回原因、详细说明、驳回人、时间
2. 首版驳回前不展示版本侧栏
3. 点击重新编辑后fork新草稿
4. 版本侧栏展示v1(被驳回)和v2(当前编辑)
5. 历史版本只读
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/Brief协作
